text:
lena: FYI opened a small PR to audit the catalog variant table + add an explicit migration checklist for deprecated variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890 :wave:

chao: Thanks. Quick skim: looks helpful. Two actionable items I saw: 1) bench links for vega13b variants are pointing at an old artifacts path, 2) the "limits" column mixes token and sequence limits which confuses readers.

emily: Re: limits column, can we split it into two subcells? i.e. "tokens (max_tokens)" and "context (max_sequence)". Tiny CSS tweak but clearer.

lena: Good call. I'll change the table markup to use stacked cells and add a footnote explaining units.

rick: Migration checklist: we should include a minimal shell workflow for validation. Suggestion: 

```bash
# run a deterministic diff to detect tokenization changes
redwood eval --model orion-xl-legacy --model-orion orion-xl-v2 --prompt-file ./smoke_prompts.txt --temperature 0.0 --output diffs.json
```

rick: That shows token-level mismatches, then you can `--traffic 5%` canary for 24h.

emily: Can we also add a short SDK snippet that shows how to programmatically check variant limits before pinning? People forget to check `concurrency` and `max_sequence`.

chao: Example snippet below (python):

```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
c = CatalogClient()
variant = c.get_variant("orion-xl-v2")
print(variant["limits"]["max_sequence"], variant["limits"]["concurrency"])
```

lena: I'll add that. Also, infra asked to annotate bench rows with the machine + profile used; I added a parenthetical: (a100-80gb, seq=2048, dyn-batching=off).

infra-bot: Artifact path check: /bench/vega13b/2026-03-21/vega13b_perf.csv -> NOT FOUND. Please re-upload or point to alternative artifact.

chao: We probably renamed the perf job. @lena can you coordinate with perf to get the new artifact?

lena: Reached out to perf team, they re-uploaded under /bench/vega13b/2026-03-23/vega13b_perf_v2.csv. Updated PR with new permalink.

docs-bot: Lint warning: table cell at /catalog/variants.md line 198 exceed 120 chars. Suggest moving rig annotation to footnote.

emily: I'll shrink the inline text and move the rig detail to the new footnote. Keeps the table narrow for mobile.

rick: One more nit: in the migration bullets we say "check tokenization" but don't show how. Maybe add a note about using `--temperature 0` + `--top_k 1` to produce deterministic outputs for diffs.

lena: Added that tip and a tiny shell snippet. Also added a brief line about quantized fallback: "If using quant variants, confirm `max_sequence` on the quant variant before routing traffic; quant builds may reduce sequence length on memory-constrained hardware."

chao: Approving content-wise; just waiting on CI artifacts and the bench CSV permalink update which you did. Leaving two small wording nits.

lena: Responded to nits and force-pushed. CI passing on docs build.

docs-bot: All checks passed except external links scan flagged an outbound link to old CLI docs. File: /sdk/old_cli.md -> 301 redirect. Consider updating to /sdk/cli or using shortlink.

emily: I'll open follow-up PR to fix CLI docs hrefs; want to keep this PR focused on variant table + migration checklist.

rick: Sounds good. Landing after merge: post-merge task to add a tiny unit test in docs CI that verifies variant links resolve (helps prevent future 404s).

lena: Great suggestion. I'll add that to the docs backlog. Merging now. :shipit:

chao: Thanks all. Good cleanup.
